typeProperties.script:
parameters{
	OLEDBDestination_outputfilename as string ()
}

source(output(
		INPUT as double,
		LEGAL_ENTITY_ID as integer,
		KNOWN_DATE as timestamp,
		END_DATE as timestamp,
		START_DATE as timestamp,
		CURRENCY_CODE as string,
		DISPLAY_NAME as string,
		FEE_ROLE as string,
		BILLING_CCY as string,
		FX_RATE as double,
		FEE_TYPE as string,
		FEE_DESC as string,
		FEE_ID as integer,
		AMOUNT as double,
		EXTERNAL_ID as integer,
		ORIGINAL_AMOUNT as double,
		OVERRIDE_AMOUNT_B as integer,
		FEE_METHOD as string,
		MANUAL_AMOUNT_B as integer,
		TRADE_ID as integer,
		FEE_DATE as timestamp,
		FEE_CONFIG_ID as integer
	),
	allowSchemaDrift: true,
	validateSchema: false) ~> OLEDBSource
OLEDBSource sink(input(
		INPUT as double,
		LEGAL_ENTITY_ID as integer,
		KNOWN_DATE as timestamp 'dd-MM-yyyy',
		END_DATE as timestamp 'dd-MM-yyyy',
		START_DATE as timestamp 'dd-MM-yyyy',
		CURRENCY_CODE as string,
		DISPLAY_NAME as string,
		FEE_ROLE as string,
		BILLING_CCY as string,
		FX_RATE as double,
		FEE_TYPE as string,
		FEE_DESC as string,
		FEE_ID as integer,
		AMOUNT as double,
		EXTERNAL_ID as integer,
		ORIGINAL_AMOUNT as double,
		OVERRIDE_AMOUNT_B as integer,
		FEE_METHOD as string,
		MANUAL_AMOUNT_B as integer,
		TRADE_ID as integer,
		FEE_DATE as timestamp 'dd-MM-yyyy',
		FEE_CONFIG_ID as integer
	),
	allowSchemaDrift: true,
	validateSchema: false,
	saveOrder: 10000,
	mapColumn(
		INPUT,
		LEGAL_ENTITY_ID,
		KNOWN_DATE,
		END_DATE,
		START_DATE,
		CURRENCY_CODE,
		DISPLAY_NAME,
		FEE_ROLE,
		BILLING_CCY,
		FX_RATE,
		FEE_TYPE,
		FEE_DESC,
		FEE_ID,
		AMOUNT,
		EXTERNAL_ID,
		ORIGINAL_AMOUNT,
		OVERRIDE_AMOUNT_B,
		FEE_METHOD,
		MANUAL_AMOUNT_B,
		TRADE_ID,
		FEE_DATE,
		FEE_CONFIG_ID),
	partitionFileNames:[($OLEDBDestination_outputfilename)],
	partitionBy('hash', 1)) ~> OLEDBDestination
